computerSettings.title: Computer use
computerSettings.subtitle: Manage how xopc observes and controls applications on your computer.
computerSettings.experimentalDescription: Computer use is experimental. It may misread the screen or perform incorrect actions. Start with non-critical tasks, watch its progress, and check the results.
computerSettings.desktopDescription: Observe and operate an application window authorized below.
computerSettings.appAccessDescription: Authorize an app here once. The agent can then observe and operate it during tasks without a prompt for every step. Window pixels and text go to the computer use model for the task, including agent-specific overrides. The agent should still ask before sending, deleting, purchasing, or other consequential actions. Revoke access or stop control at any time.
computerSettings.appListError: Could not read local applications. Check desktop permissions and try again.
computerSettings.stoppedNotice: Desktop operations stopped. Browser control is unaffected.
computerSettings.pausedNotice: Desktop control is paused. Automatic retries cannot resume it. Resume here, then start a new task.
computerSettings.browserDescription: Manage browser connections, extension setup and browser control permissions.
computerSettings.lockedDescription: Locked use is not supported. Locking your Mac or hiding xopc stops desktop control.
computerSettings.desktopRequired: Open the xopc macOS desktop app to grant access. The web console cannot approve local control.
computerSettings.unsupportedPlatform: Native desktop control is currently available only in the macOS preview.
computerSettings.accessibilityDescription: Allow xopc to interact with the authorized application window.
computerSettings.screenDescription: Allow xopc to observe the authorized window for the GUI model.
computerSettings.revoked: This device identity was revoked. Confirm re-registration on this device; existing control permissions stay unchanged.
computerSettings.modelDescription: Uses an existing compatible OpenAI API, BYOK, or xopc Cloud connection. Your chat model stays unchanged.
computerSettings.modelScope: The default for desktop tasks; agents can specify a different model. After changing it, end the current control session and start a new task.
computerSettings.noModels: No connected compatible models. Connect OpenAI API, xopc Cloud, or a Computer Use BYOK service, then refresh the model catalog.
computerSettings.noModel: Not selected (does not inherit chat model)
computerSettings.modelUnavailable: This model cannot currently be selected. Check the connection, catalog and protocol compatibility. No automatic model switching.
computerSettings.modelPrivacy: Computer use applies to all configured computer use models, including models specified by individual agents. Window screenshots and text pass through this Gateway to the task’s model service, with no automatic provider switching. Screenshots are not stored in chat history; window text may appear there.
computerSettings.nativeError: Cannot read desktop status. Check the desktop application and try again.
computerSettings.safety: App authorization, OS permissions, single-window limits and sensitive-app restrictions still apply. Browser permissions are separate. Stop here or from the tray at any time; resume manually when ready.
